According to ruling [3], while Rest in Peace is on the battlefield, abilities that trigger whenever a creature dies won't trigger because cards and tokens are never put into a player's graveyard. Since Blood Artist's ability triggers "whenever this creature or another creature dies," it relies on creatures being put into graveyards, which Rest in Peace prevents by exiling them instead [2]. Therefore, Blood Artist's ability does not trigger under the influence of Rest in Peace.

messy-misspelled-keyword.question: wrath of god vs indestructable creature, does it survive?

full.answer:
Yes, an indestructible creature survives when "Wrath of God" is cast [1][2]. 

"Worath of God" destroys all creatures [1], but according to rule 702.12b, a permanent with indestructible cannot be destroyed and ignores the state-based action that checks for lethal damage [2]. Therefore, an indestructible creature will not be affected by "Wrath of God."

In Magic: The Gathering, a player's maximum hand size is normally seven cards [2]. This can be modified by the hand modifier of a vanguard card, which adjusts both the starting and maximum hand sizes accordingly [3][4].

If multiple effects modify your hand size, they are applied in timestamp order. For example, if you control Vnwxt, Verbose Host (which removes any maximum hand size restriction) and another effect that sets a different maximum hand size, these effects will be cumulative and resolved based on the order they entered play [9][11][12].

Vnwxt, Verbose Host specifically states that it grants "no maximum hand size" to its controller. This means that while Vnwxt is in play under your control, you are not subject to any maximum hand size restrictions, regardless of other effects or modifiers [14]. 

Therefore, if you have Vnwxt on the battlefield and no other effects modifying your hand size, you can hold an unlimited number of cards in your hand. If there are additional effects that modify hand size, they would be applied according to their timestamps, but as long as Vnwxt is controlling the effect, it will override any maximum hand size restrictions [9][11][12].
